title: The water cycle, from my own notes
brief: A two-lesson science class built from the textbook and lesson plans I wrote myself. My files are in inputs/textbook.md and inputs/lesson-plans/; convert them without rewriting, add discussion topics and assessments, and let me sign off before it goes to upubhub.

answers.subject_scope: Evaporation, condensation, precipitation and collection, with everyday examples. No climate policy.
